query:
UPDATE purchaseRequests
SET status = 'aguardando_controladoria', updatedAt = NOW()
WHERE id IN (1230001, 1890001, 1710001, 1980003, 1980002, 1800002, 1980001, 1770001, 2010003)
  AND urgencyLevel IN ('urgente', 'emergencial')
  AND status IN ('aguardando_orcamento', 'aguardando_diretoria');
